steps.title: Past timeline: background, event and earlier cause
steps.body: Choose the past tense from the timeline, not from an English translation. The imparfait gives a background or repeated situation; the passé composé advances the story with a completed event; the plus-que-parfait marks something that had already happened before that event. The conditionnel passé can evaluate a missed option (il aurait fallu consulter…), but it does not prove what would have happened. Keep the sequence explicit with avant que, après que, à la suite de and time markers.

steps.title: Past timeline: background, event and earlier cause
rows: La ville a fermé une voie pendant les travaux.
The city closed a lane during construction.
Les résidents avaient déjà signalé le bruit.
Residents had already reported the noise.
Il aurait fallu prévoir un accès temporaire.
A temporary entrance should have been planned.

steps.explain: The imparfait commonly describes background or repeated situations.

steps.prompt: Residents had already complained before work began. Which tense marks the earlier action?
steps.explain: The plus-que-parfait marks the action that preceded the past event.

steps.prompt: What does il aurait fallu express here?
options: A past recommendation or missed necessity
steps.explain: The conditional past can express what would have been necessary.
